# Arc'teryx

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 7 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

Arc'teryx is a public outdoor shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://arcteryx.com](https://arcteryx.com) on 2026-11-22. The shop redirected to [https://arcteryx.com/ca/en](https://arcteryx.com/ca/en), the Canada English storefront. The utility bar shows a Canadian flag and EN. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, Women's Shell Jackets, one public product, and Who we are were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

The shared preview browser landed on the same Canada URL, then failed to produce screenshot frames twice. The shots here are from a later headless Chromium pass of the same public URLs.

`catalog.json` and `webapps-manifest.json` were left alone. `login-extracted` stays `not-started`.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
